source_inputs.definition: Frozen possible application/test input files; this count is not a count of executed modules

package_combined_verified_files.definition: Union of package_module_files and protobuf_binding_verified_files; not the full package manifest

limitations: All account/order/market/cash/permit values and peers are explicit synthetic inputs. Source authentication and real authority are not established.
No SDK top-level import, OpenD, DNS, external endpoint, real account or model request; production worker admission and permissions remain unchanged.
2201 observations are cumulative order fields, not a 2211 per-fill query. 2211 and 2225 were not invoked.
2205 C2S numeric orderID=0 follows pinned SDK; original opaque orderIDEx is bound from journal. S2C required numeric ID is fictional 44, not the source of authority.
ACK and cancel ACK are not fill/fee/economic finality; exact filled notional and fees remain unknown, reservation is not released.
Quote loss is an explicit confirmed-state injection plus actual owned socket close and peer EOF; no production FIN detection/recovery is claimed.

Recovery restores original bytes/permit times and original journal observation/identity without new request encoding, order adoption, connection, send or journal changes. Constructors still serialize unused synthetic response messages.
Registry is trusted test prebinding data, never identity authority or a shadow business ledger.
Actual generated protobuf is mandatory; no missing-package skip or fake fallback. Standard CI uses named JSON fakes and is counted separately.
This source-plus-private-runtime probe is not r7 feature/package bootstrap or production performance acceptance.
